title: Manali, Kasol & Kheerganga
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi or Chandigarh. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
overview:
The full Himachal hit-list: this **4 Nights / 5 Days** group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening for an overnight journey to Manali.

Day 1 covers Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road with a bonfire dinner. Day 2 takes in Solang Valley, the Atal Tunnel and Sissu. Day 3 drives to Kasol via Kullu, where Beas rafting and paragliding are optional (own cost), for a camp night with a bonfire. Day 4 is the Kheerganga trek from Barsheni (5 to 6 hours) and a night at the campsite. Day 5 starts with a hot spring bath at Kheerganga, treks down and visits Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara before the overnight journey home. Prices start at ₹12,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
highlights: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road
Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel to Sissu
Optional Beas rafting and paragliding in Kullu (own cost)
Camp night in Kasol with a bonfire and light music
Kheerganga trek (5 to 6 hours from Barsheni), camping and hot springs

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi / Chandigarh
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to Manali in an AC Tempo Traveller or bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Manali | Hadimba Temple | Old Manali | Mall Road
itinerary.content:
Reach Manali in the morning, check in at the hotel and freshen up.
Local sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road.
Back to the hotel for dinner with a bonfire and light music.
Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley | Atal Tunnel | Sissu
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head out for the day.
Cover Solang Valley en route, drive through the Atal Tunnel and enjoy the views from Sissu Valley.
Back to the hotel in the evening for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol via Kullu | Camp night
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Leave for Kasol via Kullu, reaching in the evening. On the way, Beas river rafting and paragliding in Kullu are optional (own cost).
Check in to the camps in Kasol for dinner with a bonfire and light music.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga trek
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Drive to Barsheni, the base for the trek.
Trek to Kheerganga Top (5 to 6 hours), reaching in the evening.
Hot dinner and overnight stay at the campsite.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga to Manikaran | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early for a hot spring bath at Kheerganga, then breakfast.
Trek down to Barsheni, reaching in the evening.
Transfer to Manikaran and visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara.
Depart for home, reaching the next day. Tour ends.

includes: Stay: 2 nights in a hotel in Manali, 1 night in Kasol and 1 night at Kheerganga
AC tempo traveller, Innova or AC deluxe bus, as per group size
All sightseeing as mentioned in the itinerary
excludes: Food and beverages not included in the package
Rafting, paragliding and other adventure activities
Costs from natural calamities or circumstances beyond our control
Any other expense not listed under the inclusions

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh every Friday evening for an overnight journey to Manali. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Manali, Kasol & Kheerganga trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹12,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹13,000 on triple sharing and ₹14,000 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in a Manali hotel, 1 night in Kasol camps and 1 night at Kheerganga, 8 meals (4 breakfasts and 4 dinners), AC transport as per group size, all sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire with music and a tour curator.

faqs.q: How long is the Kheerganga trek?
faqs.a: The trek from Barsheni to Kheerganga Top takes 5 to 6 hours on Day 4. You spend the night at the campsite and trek back down to Barsheni on Day 5.
The first two nights are in a hotel in Manali, the third in camps in Kasol and the fourth at the Kheerganga campsite. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
